verdict.rationale: Pika's pricing materials state commercial-use rights. The pricing page lists "Commercial use: For clients, brands, and paid work," and the llms.txt says the $10/month Starter plan includes a "commercial license." That answers the commercial-use half of the story, though which plans carry the license, including the Free tier, is not spelled out. Nothing in the evidence addresses who owns the generated output or quotes actual terms-of-service language. Missing for 10: an explicit output-ownership statement, per-plan clarity on commercial rights including Free, and terms-of-service or licensing text rather than pricing-page bullets.
